name: Test of Lore
summary: In the Undercity, initiates face a test of history with Parqual Fintallas. They have scoured the world for historical texts, and this examination is part of spiritual trials begun in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Trial of Knowledge
sections.body: The Test of Lore is one of the spiritual trials begun in Thousand Needles. Dorn Plainstalker set the trials at the Weathered Nook. This examination carries candidates from the wind-carved canyons of Thousand Needles to the Undercity, where Parqual Fintallas tests their knowledge of history and holds each seeker to a high standard.

sections.title: The Scourge's Genesis
sections.body: Parqual Fintallas tests initiates on the book 'Beginnings of the Undead Threat,' which tells how the Scourge began in Lordaeron. He asks about the being on the Frozen Throne: Ner'zhul, once an elder shaman, whose essence the Burning Legion forged into the Lich King. This grim lineage helps explain the Forsaken's existence and the dangers facing Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: What is the answer to Parqual's question?
faq.answer: Parqual Fintallas asks for the Lich King's original name: Ner'zhul, the ancient orc shaman whose spirit was bound to the Frozen Throne.

faq.q: What happens if you answer the question wrong?
faq.answer: A wrong answer gives you the Mark of Shame debuff. You must wait out the penalty before Parqual lets you try the examination again.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: where does test of lore start
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker begins the wider series of spiritual trials at the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles, among its towering spires.
Parqual Fintallas is in the Undercity, among the Forsaken's underground libraries and corridors, where he examines prospective students.

faq.q: What text is this trial based on?
aliases: which book for test of lore
faq.answer: The test draws on 'Beginnings of the Undead Threat,' a book about the origins of the Plague of Undeath and the making of the Lich King.

faq.q: Why is a Thousand Needles quest sending people to Undercity?
faq.answer: The tauren's trials challenge every part of an adventurer. For this examination, candidates cross the sea to seek scholarly records kept in the ruins of Lordaeron.

angles.text: As a tauren, you follow an elder tradition that sends you to learn the grim histories of your northern Forsaken allies and the world beyond Kalimdor.
As undead, you face a history bound to Forsaken identity: Ner'zhul's tragic transformation and the curse that bound you before Sylvanas broke the Lich King's grip.
As a member of the Horde, you strengthen ties between Kalimdor's tribes and the kingdom beneath Lordaeron, and learn that wisdom matters as much to survival as strength.
